paper_title: A Spectroscopic Search for Optical Emission Lines from Dark Matter Decay
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from the paper's stated two-photon decay rate limit Gamma < 3.3e-26 s^-1 (lifetime > 3e25 s) via Gamma = g^2 m^3 / (64 pi)
notes: DESI stacked dark-sky spectroscopy search for monoenergetic optical emission from DM two-photon decay around BGS/LRG galaxies at ~50 kpc impact parameter. Primary result is on the Gamma-vs-m plane (Fig. 8, 5-sigma detection limits); no plot digitization available, so the flat lifetime bound tau > 3e25 s (Gamma < ~3.3e-26 s^-1) quoted for m = 5-12 eV was converted to g_agamma using Gamma = g^2 m^3/64pi and hbar = 6.582e-16 eV s. Actual Fig. 8 curves vary by factor ~few in Gamma (~sqrt(few) in g) across the band; shaded bands reflect ~30% surface-mass-density systematic from SDSS lensing extrapolation. Paper quotes 5-sigma limits, more conservative than the 95% CL of comparison MUSE/VIMOS bounds; confidence_level field set to 0.95 as closest allowed value.
